meta.title: Integrate cached block decomposition
meta.body_summary: Add caching of the first-order block decomposition after derivative computation, reuse it across model solves, and update the benchmark script to use the cached decomposition for faster repeated evaluations.

perf_labels.notes: PR caches block decomposition for repeated solves but closed without review; no performance evidence or reviewer feedback.
